## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `enum_options` | `array of string` | no | The allowed values, for an `enum` field. |
| `required` | `boolean` | no | Whether a value is required. |
| `is_pii` | `boolean` | no | Whether the field holds personal data. |
| `show_in_portal` | `boolean` | no | Whether the customer portal shows the field. |
| `position` | `integer` | no | The field's sort position; lower numbers come first. |
| `archived` | `boolean` | no | True if the field is archived. |
| `expected_version` | `integer` | no | The `resource_version` you last read. The update fails with 409 if the field changed since. |

| `filter_kind` | `string` | The filter kind this field compares as. Use it to pick the value control; the field is filterable as `cf_<api_name>` on that entity's list. One of `text`, `enum`, `number`, `bool`, `date`. |
